info.title: WooCommerce, WordPress and Redirection REST APIs read by frappe-idempotent-importer
info.description: WooCommerce publishes no OpenAPI document. This subset is transcribed from the property tables of the official WooCommerce REST API v3 documentation (https://woocommerce.github.io/woocommerce-rest-api-docs/), the WordPress REST API handbook's schema tables (https://developer.wordpress.org/rest-api/reference/pages/, posts/, categories/, users/) and the Redirection plugin's own OpenAPI document (https://redirection.me/developer/rest-api/), all fetched 2026-10-16; each schema and operation cites its section. Only the responses the WooCommerce adapter reads are included, with every documented property. Types are as documented, except where WooCommerce serialises differently from its docs: date-time values, and the properties whose description says so, are null when unset; an order line's price is a number; meta values are free-form. Objects stay open (additional properties allowed) because plugins add fields. Required properties are the identifiers and the fields the adapter cannot do without.
